workspace.title: Name your workspace
workspace.description: A workspace holds your hosts, repositories and run history. You can rename it later; the address is permanent.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.hint: Letters, numbers and hyphens. This is the address your team signs in at.
workspace.claimFailed: We could not save that workspace.
workspace.checkFailed: We could not check that address. Try again in a moment.

github.title: Connect GitHub
github.description: This installs the Oppenheimer GitHub App on your account. You pick all repositories or selected ones on GitHub's own page.
github.skipNote: You can add repositories later in Settings. The repo picker stays empty until you do.
github.failed: We could not connect that GitHub installation.
github.unstarted: This GitHub link was not started here. Connect GitHub again.

host.title: Add your first host
host.description: Run one command on the server you want sessions on — a cloud VM, a build box, or your workstation. Nothing on it is exposed to the internet.
host.skipNote: You can pair a machine later. Sessions need one before they can run.

ready.title: You're all set
ready.description: {{workspace}} is ready. Start a session and watch every step it takes.
